topic: Our place in the Milky Way
script: The Milky Way is about 100,000 light-years across. Our solar system sits about halfway out from the center, in a spiral arm. The Sun takes about 230 million years to circle the galaxy once. The last time we were in this spot, the first dinosaurs were just appearing. At the center sits a supermassive black hole called Sagittarius A star.
